entities.name: PMID:27499721
observations: 13C-glucose endometabolomics in hippocampal neurons/preparations reported glycerol-3-phosphate biosynthesis activated during LTP and silenced at baseline; association does not establish necessity.

entities.name: PMID:35999055
observations: Hippocampal neuronal glycerol-3-phosphate shuttle supports electrical activity under constrained mitochondrial bioenergetic conditions; this is not direct LTP evidence.

entities.name: G3P biosynthesis and LTP
observations: A 2016 isotope-tracing study reported G3P biosynthesis activation in response to hippocampal LTP, supporting activity-linked association but not causation or necessity.
